You are implementing Task C1 of an implementation plan: create a new `vector.tf` in the `eks-cluster-applications` Terraform module that wires the new `vector` internal-module into the layer-3 consumer.

## Context

- Working directory: `/Users/steve.briggs/projects/IAC/terraform/iac-library/aws/compute/eks-cluster-applications`
- Sibling pattern: `otel_collector.tf` in the same directory (already exists). Read it for conventions: locals derivation, module call shape, REQUIRED/OPTIONAL section headers, `_enabled_cluster_types` map pattern, validation block pattern.
- `common.tf` defines `local.cluster_type` and providers.
- `application_deployment.tf` shows the `data "external" "validate"` pattern used to enforce cross-module dependencies.
- The new vector internal-module lives at `git@gitlab.infrastructure.immuta.io:infrastructure/terraform/internal-modules/kubernetes/monitoring/vector.git` and will be tagged `v1.0.0` after Sir Charles handles the git work. For now, the source ref should be the eventual `?ref=v1.0.0` even though the tag doesn't exist yet — `terraform validate` won't try to fetch the module without `terraform init`, and we run `init -backend=false` separately.
- The `external_secrets` module's outputs (read `external_secrets.tf` if present in this directory) — find the output that exposes the ClusterSecretStore name. If the external-secrets module doesn't expose one, the integration may need to use `var.external_secrets_vault_secret_name` or another existing variable. Read carefully and document any uncertainty in your report.

## Task Description (verbatim from plan)

### Task C1: Create `vector.tf` — locals + module call

**Files:**
- Create: `vector.tf`

Write `vector.tf`:

```hcl
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VECTOR
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
locals {
  vector_enabled = (
    var.vector_enabled != null
    ? var.vector_enabled
    : lookup(var.vector_enabled_cluster_types, local.cluster_type, true)
  )
  vector_endpoint = "http://vector.vector.svc.cluster.local:4317"
}

module "vector" {
  source = "git@gitlab.infrastructure.immuta.io:infrastructure/terraform/internal-modules/kubernetes/monitoring/vector.git?ref=v1.0.0"
  count  = local.vector_enabled ? 1 : 0

  providers = {
    kubernetes = kubernetes.local-cluster
    helm       = helm.local-cluster
  }

  chart_version               = var.vector_chart_version
  image                       = var.vector_image
  image_tag_version           = var.vector_image_tag
  replicas                    = var.vector_replicas
  datadog_site                = var.vector_datadog_site
  datadog_api_key_vault_path  = var.vector_datadog_api_key_vault_path
  audit_drop_patterns         = var.vector_audit_drop_patterns
  email_redaction_enabled     = var.vector_email_redaction_enabled
  email_redaction_replacement = var.vector_email_redaction_replacement
  additional_config           = var.vector_additional_config

  # NOTE: Confirm the right consumer-side reference for the ClusterSecretStore
  # name during Phase C implementation. Read module.external_secrets outputs in
  # this directory; pass whichever output exposes the ClusterSecretStore name.
  # If no such output exists, add one in the external-secrets internal-module
  # first.
  external_secrets_cluster_store_name = module.external_secrets[0].cluster_secret_store_name

  depends_on = [
    module.cilium,
    module.external_secrets,
  ]
}

data "external" "vector_validate" {
  count = local.vector_enabled && !local.external_secrets_enabled ? 1 : 0

  program = ["Error: vector can only be set if external-secrets is enabled as well"]
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# REQUIRED PARAMETERS (when vector enabled)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
variable "vector_chart_version" {
  description = "Version of vector helm chart"
  type        = string
  default     = ""
  validation {
    condition     = var.vector_chart_version == "" && local.vector_enabled ? false : true
    error_message = "vector_chart_version must be set when vector is enabled"
  }
}

variable "vector_image_tag" {
  description = "Vector image tag"
  type        = string
  default     = ""
  validation {
    condition     = var.vector_image_tag == "" && local.vector_enabled ? false : true
    error_message = "vector_image_tag must be set when vector is enabled"
  }
}

variable "vector_datadog_site" {
  description = "Datadog site for vector sinks (e.g. datadoghq.com)"
  type        = string
  default     = ""
  validation {
    condition     = var.vector_datadog_site == "" && local.vector_enabled ? false : true
    error_message = "vector_datadog_site must be set when vector is enabled"
  }
}

variable "vector_datadog_api_key_vault_path" {
  description = "Vault path for the Datadog API key (consumed by ExternalSecret in vector ns)"
  type        = string
  default     = ""
  validation {
    condition     = var.vector_datadog_api_key_vault_path == "" && local.vector_enabled ? false : true
    error_message = "vector_datadog_api_key_vault_path must be set when vector is enabled"
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OPTIONAL PARAMETERS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
variable "vector_enabled_cluster_types" {
  description = "Types of clusters Vector should be enabled on by default"
  type        = map(bool)
  default = {
    "mgmt"  = true
    "cps"   = true
    "saas"  = true
    "infra" = false
    "dev"   = false
  }
}

variable "vector_enabled" {
  description = "Override for explicitly enabling or disabling Vector"
  type        = bool
  default     = null
}

variable "vector_image" {
  description = "Image for Vector"
  type        = string
  default     = "registry.ic-ops.net/cache-docker-hub/timberio/vector"
}

variable "vector_replicas" {
  description = "Number of Vector aggregator replicas"
  type        = number
  default     = 3
}

variable "vector_audit_drop_patterns" {
  description = "Regex patterns; matching log message bodies are dropped"
  type        = list(string)
  default = [
    "Audit\\s-\\s.+",
    "\"level\":\"audit\"",
  ]
}

variable "vector_email_redaction_enabled" {
  description = "Toggle the email-redact VRL transform across all signals"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "vector_email_redaction_replacement" {
  description = "String that replaces matched email addresses"
  type        = string
  default     = "[REDACTED-EMAIL]"
}

variable "vector_additional_config" {
  description = "Alternate helm chart customConfig (overwrites entire helm config)"
  type        = any
  default     = null
}
```
